name: hbm_su_pslice_c5_lp8a

pin_regs.reason: every parent input lands on a child pin register (head c_* / leaf start-length stage) or a landing ring in its region; every output leaves a child register (leaf command / status, head fault); a kit flop stage would add an edge the landed record does not price

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands every regional reset port: rst_n_<r> has ONE sink, u_lpr_<r> (ot_pl_pad N 3 on ck_<r> beside its pin: 2 landing stages + 1 reach relay; lp.py regional_reset_ports, priced in the landed record: reset release +3); a kit landing would add 2 unpriced release edges

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: PASS: every input lands on a child pin register (head c_* stage) or a landing ring; every output leaves a child register; each regional reset port lands 2 stages (+1 reach relay) on its own root beside its pin (RTL u_lpr_<r>, lp regional_reset_ports)
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: PASS: no single-cycle reset or data hop over a region boundary; head ring -> leaf read is the E = 3 multicycle landing (<= ~1.9 mm, 2.5 ns at 833 ps); reset relay stage 3 covers the 453.6-um L leaf; read -> cfg pin <= 260 um on S leaves (r8b)
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: PASS: regional reset lpr_<r> loads <= 12 (one leaf's read halves + status rings + child pad); h <= 28 (7 rings + 20 reads + head)
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS: landing read = 8:1 registered slot mux (lp ot_pl_land_r); no combinational in -> out path (all child-registered)
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: ring banks are D = 8 slot landings (fixed-latency rings, not runtime-indexed storage); leaf storage is SRAM in the hard leaves
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: PASS: children on the 43.2 lattice, 43.2-um command strips + 151-um cfg channel; child faces <= 3.5 pins/um (head W 302 / 86.4); fill 57% (1.03 mm2 macros / 1.81 mm2); aspect 2:1; fences 6.48 um off every macro edge, <= 21.6 tall
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: FIXED (real7 FAIL): 11 regional roots, each entry at its leaf's own clk pin; tree <= one leaf footprint; landed crossings between every pair; io_hold_margin 0.03; hard-child clock references from views/<child>/insertion.json
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: PASS: static; compiler record pslice_c5_r8: leaves +4 edges, reset release +3 (was +6), head status lag 8 (unchanged)

slot_change_request: H-D4G pgp_<q> (r8, supersedes the real7 request): same slot 1900.8 x 950.4; PORT CHANGE: 11 region clocks ck_h (W, head) + ck_c0..ck_c9 (each under / over its leaf's clk pin: c0..c4 S face, c5..c9 N face) and 11 regional resets rst_n_h / rst_n_c<k> (beside each clock; the die releases all 11 on the SAME edge, each timed on its own region clock: die obligation in the record); command split per leaf command_c0..c8[255:0] + command_c9[117:0] (command = {command_c9, .., command_c0}); busy/valid/done/edge_index on ck_c0; every output +4 edges, reset release +3 (was +6)
why_floorplan: unchanged from real7: two leaf rows facing one configuration channel, head at its W end; r8 changes only the clock / reset regions (one per leaf) and, in variant b, the S leaves' landing boxes
structural_change: L2H-PSLICE 10-19 r8 (after real7 FAIL: cross_clock u_lpr_root -> u_lpr_t / u_lpr_b -112 / -136 ps TT, per-root child-flop spread h 97 / l 568 / t 286 / b 156 ps, GRT stall): 11 clock regions (head + one per leaf, entry at the leaf's clk pin), 11 regional reset ports landed on their own roots (no reset root, no cross-region reset path), per-leaf command ports; landings unchanged (90, D 8, E = K = 3, 27 shared rings, per-leaf reads, 6,399 flops). Variant a: reads on the cfg face, status rings on the command face
